anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, or generated opportunities, suggesting a potential malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading activity is stagnant with no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which may indicate issues with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system failure.
Review and potentially restart or reconfigure AI components to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading strategies.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and consider adjustments or alternative strategies to improve trading activity.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to identify why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
